resources.string: Clear Travel encrypts everything it stores - journeys, trips, documents and backups - with a password only you know. Create it now; you’ll need it to open the app.
If you forget this password, your data is lost
There is no reset, no recovery e-mail and no way for anyone to unlock your data without it - not even Google Drive backups, which are encrypted with the same password. Save it in a password manager.
Use your fingerprint or face instead of typing the password. The password still works.
No fingerprint or face is set up on this device. You can turn this on later in Settings → Security.
Enter your password to open your travel data.
Biometric unlock was turned off because the device’s biometrics changed. Unlock with your password and turn it back on in Settings.
Opening your encrypted storage. The first time after an update this can take a moment while existing data is encrypted.
Your data could not be opened. Free up some storage space and try again.
Connect a Google account and Clear Travel keeps an encrypted copy of your backups in your Drive - only this app, with your password, can read them. You can also connect later from Settings.
Google features are not configured in this build, so connecting is unavailable. Everything else works offline.
Restore a backup or start fresh?
If you used Clear Travel before, bring your journeys, trips, checklists and documents back from a backup. Otherwise start with an empty app.
Pick a Clear Travel backup file you exported earlier (for example from your Downloads folder).
Your account is connected, but Drive access was not granted. You can grant it later in Settings → Google account → Back up to Drive.
Checking your Drive for Clear Travel backups…
No Clear Travel backups were found in this Google Drive.
%1$d backup(s) found - tap one to restore it.
This backup is encrypted. Enter the password it was created with to restore it.
This may differ from the password you just created: a backup is sealed with the password of the Clear Travel install that made it. Use that one here.
That password does not open this backup. Try again.
Could not connect the Google account. You can try again or continue offline.
This backup was made by a newer Clear Travel. Update the app, then restore it.
That file is not a readable Clear Travel backup.
The backup could not be read. Check the connection or pick the file again.
